achievements.name: First Shipment
achievements.detail: Ship a crop you grew and collect the gold for it the next day.

achievements.name: Level Ten
achievements.detail: Reach level 10 in farming, mining, foraging, fishing, or combat.

achievements.name: Bottom of the Mines
achievements.detail: Reach the lowest floor of the mines in the mountains.

achievements.name: Community Center
achievements.detail: Complete the community center bundles, or finish the Joja development that takes its place.

achievements.name: Ten Hearts
achievements.detail: Fill all ten friendship hearts with one villager.

achievements.name: Wedding Day
achievements.detail: Marry a villager and hold the wedding on the farm.

achievements.name: House Upgraded
achievements.detail: Buy every upgrade Robin offers for the farmhouse.

achievements.name: Museum Complete
achievements.detail: Donate every artifact and mineral the museum has a place for.

achievements.name: Every Fish
achievements.detail: Catch each fish species that can be reeled in around Stardew Valley.

achievements.name: Skull Cavern
achievements.detail: Reach the desert and enter Skull Cavern.

achievements.name: Ginger Island
achievements.detail: Repair Willy's boat and set foot on Ginger Island.

achievements.name: Grandpa's Evaluation
achievements.detail: Meet the standard Grandpa set for the farm when the shrine is judged at the start of year three.

achievements.name: Perfection
achievements.detail: Complete every remaining task on the valley's endgame checklist.
